overview_description.description:
The financial infrastructure trusted by global businesses to accelerate cross-border operations. From fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 companies, the world's most ambitious businesses choose PingPong to power their international expansion at unprecedented speed.

Our compliance-first platform delivers real-time processing, transparent pricing, and regulatory coverage across 60+ licences for secure global growth. Transform payment complexity into competitive advantage with straight-through processing, higher authorisation rates, and infrastructure that scales with your ambitions.

Since 2015, we've built the financial backbone for global commerce. From our New York founding, we've scaled to 40 offices worldwide with 1,600+ employees, processing over $350 billion for enterprises and startups expanding internationally.

Our mission since day 1 has been to accelerate the digital transformation of global trade by eliminating payment barriers and connecting trade ecosystems. We build infrastructure that helps businesses succeed in a digital-first future.

product.name: PingPong Platform and API
product.description: An API-driven cross-border payment infrastructure platform for businesses, financial institutions, fintechs, and SaaS companies to collect, convert, manage, and disburse funds globally.

product.name: Local Accounts
product.description: Multi-currency receiving accounts that let businesses collect marketplace, customer, and commercial payments into accounts in their own name across supported currencies.

product.name: Payout Capabilities
product.description: Global disbursement services for sending funds through local payment rails and bank networks to recipients in more than 200 countries and regions.

product.name: Foreign Exchange
product.description: Currency conversion and FX risk-management services for businesses holding, exchanging, and paying in multiple currencies.

product.name: Supplier Payments
product.description: International accounts-payable services for paying suppliers, service providers, tax authorities, freelancers, and contractors in local currencies.

product.name: Card Issuing
product.description: A card-issuing service for creating globally accepted cards for customers, employees, contractors, or business spending programs.
